subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects entities and individuals holding specific coal leases issued under a system of deferred bonus payment.
dimensions.evidence: The bonus payments for a lease issued under this subsection under a system of deferred bonus payment shall be payable in 10 equal annual installments

dimensions.assessment: Changes the payment structure of lease bonus payments into 10 annual installments rather than alternative schedules.
Strestches federal collection of bonus payment revenues over a 10-year period, though exact monetary amounts are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: payable in 10 equal annual installments, the first of which shall be submitted with the bid

dimensions.assessment: Amends a single section of the Mineral Leasing Act regarding coal lease payment terms.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2(a) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 201(a)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change affecting qualifying coal leases over a 10-year installment schedule per lease.

missing_information: Total monetary value of bonus payments affected
Number of current or future leases utilizing deferred bonus payment systems
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Mineral Leasing Act to mandate that bonus payments for certain deferred coal leases be payable in 10 equal annual installments. The effect is limited to parties involved in qualifying deferred bonus payment coal leases.
